terms.meaning: A letter that stands for a number that is unknown or can change.
Terms with the same letter-numbers, such as 5c and 3c.
Terms with different letter-numbers, such as 3a and 2b. They cannot be joined into one term.

items.name: From words to an expression
items.formula: Use a letter for the number that changes
items.example: c coconuts at ₹35 each cost 35c rupees.

items.name: Finding the value
items.formula: Put the number in place of the letter

items.name: Subtracting a bracket
items.formula: Change the sign of each term inside

mistakes.text: 3d does not mean writing 3 next to the number. If d = 6, 3d is 18, not 36.
Unlike terms stay apart. 3a + 2b is not 5ab.
10y − 3 and 10(y − 3) are different. If y = 5, they are 47 and 20.
A minus before a bracket changes every term inside. 9 − (x + 2) = 7 − x, not 11 − x.
